subject: general
question: In which of the following months, during the ‘Genomics Data Conclave’, was the 'GenomeIndia Data' dedicated to the researchers by Narendra Modi, Prime Minister of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jan 2025 **__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Genomics Data Conclave**: The Genomics Data Conclave is a significant event aimed at advancing genomic research and data sharing among scientists and researchers in India.
 
• **'GenomeIndia Data' dedication**: During the conclave, Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** dedicated the **'GenomeIndia Data'** to researchers to promote scientific innovation and exploration in genomics.
 
• The event took place on **January 1, 2025**, marking the official launch of this initiative to enhance India's capabilities in genomic data analysis and research.
 
• **Significance of the data**: The 'GenomeIndia Data' is expected to contribute to advancements in healthcare, personalized medicine, and biotechnology by enabling scientists to better understand the genetic makeup of India's diverse population.
 
• The **Prime Minister's involvement** underscores the importance of genomic research in shaping the future of healthcare and other scientific innovations in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **GenomeIndia Project**:

 
 
• The **GenomeIndia Project** is a national initiative launched by the Government of India to map the genetic diversity of the Indian population.
 
• It aims to collect and analyze genome samples from across the country to build a comprehensive database for scientific research and healthcare applications.
 
• This project is expected to help identify genetic disorders, improve disease diagnosis, and facilitate the development of personalized medicine.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Genomics**:
 
 
• Genomics is the study of the complete set of DNA (including all genes) within an organism. It plays a crucial role in understanding hereditary diseases and developing targeted treatments.
 
• Advancements in genomics have paved the way for revolutionary technologies like CRISPR and personalized gene therapy.
 
 
 
• **Applications of Genomic Data**:
 
 
• Genomic data is used in **healthcare** for early diagnosis of diseases, drug development, and creating personalized treatment plans.
 
• In agriculture, it helps in **crop improvement** and developing pest-resistant varieties.
 
• It also has applications in **forensic science** for solving crimes and identifying individuals.
 
 
 
• **Global Genomic Initiatives**:
 
 
• Similar projects worldwide include the **Human Genome Project (HGP)**, which successfully mapped the entire human genome in 2003.
 
• Countries like the USA, UK, and China are investing heavily in genomic research to address public health challenges and innovate in biotechnology.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Role**: His active involvement in science and technology initiatives reflects India's commitment to advancing research and innovation.
 
• **Genomic Data Accessibility**: The dedication of 'GenomeIndia Data' ensures that researchers have access to high-quality genomic data, fostering collaboration and innovation in the field of genomics.
 
• **Healthcare Benefits**: The insights gained from genomics research can significantly improve healthcare delivery, particularly in a diverse country like India.
 
• **Future Prospects**: The GenomeIndia Project and initiatives like the Genomics Data Conclave are expected to position India as a global leader in genomic research and personalized medicine.
